data.description:
## Goal
Document that the project's AWS account (us-east-1) is reached through the `frontier` AWS CLI profile, so agents and contributors pass `--profile frontier` (or `AWS_PROFILE=frontier`) on every `aws` command. Today the requirement appears only incidentally (`infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap/README.md`, `tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/README.md`); the runbooks' `aws ...` lines and the local setup TL;DR (`export AWS_PROFILE=...`) leave it unstated, so an agent runs `aws` against the default chain and fails or hits the wrong account.

## Plan
1. `AGENTS.md`: add one short paragraph beside the Gerrit credential guidance stating the rule: every `aws` CLI call passes `--profile frontier` (region us-east-1), including the commands in `infra/runbooks/`; never put credentials in rebar config or tickets.
2. `docs/local-dev-env.md` TL;DR: replace `export AWS_PROFILE=...` with `export AWS_PROFILE=frontier`, with a comment naming it as the project's AWS profile.
3. Verification: `make lint` passes, and the documentation tests that scan AGENTS.md and docs pass (`pytest tests/ -k "agents_md or docs" -q` subset run locally); CI's Verified vote covers the full suite.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AGENTS.md states that every `aws` CLI command passes `--profile frontier` (us-east-1), including runbook commands.
- [ ] docs/local-dev-env.md's TL;DR exports `AWS_PROFILE=frontier`.
- [ ] The change is merged on main with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.

## File impact (expected)
- AGENTS.md
- docs/local-dev-env.md
data.title: Document the frontier AWS CLI profile for agents and contributors
